_how_it_is_used: server_scripts/grindless/uhv/gate.js makes one recipe per entry, id grindless:<type>/<name>, with its programmed circuit (one recipe per lookup path). 'kept' items are catalysts (not consumed). site: orbits = Earth orbit and Proxima b's orbit (the two ends of the gate); proxima_b_orbit = Proxima b's orbit only. Machine 18 (warp gate) and machine 25 (baseline astrometer): docs/eras/uhv.md lines 483-495 and 570-585.

recipes._why: UIV-B1: c4 jump to RX J1856 from Sirius B; named hold_ so the gate's overclock stays identity at 16 A UIV
recipes.name: hold_rx_j1856

recipes._why: UIV-B1: c5 jump to PSR J0437 from Sirius B
recipes.name: hold_psr_j0437

recipes._why: UIV-B1: c6 jump to Cygnus X-1 from Sirius B; reads B2's pellet and B3's solution by their F1 ids
recipes.name: hold_cygnus_x1

recipes._why: UIV-B5: c7 hold at Cygnus X-1, 16 A x V[UIV] for 60 s; the stored items stay in the bus (gate to UXV)
recipes.name: hold_cygnus_ring

recipes._why: UXV-B1: c8 jump to the Vela Pulsar from Cygnus X-1; the launched seed and the FRC cartridge (B3's) are both spent, 16 A x V[UIV] for 60 s
recipes.name: hold_vela_pulsar

recipes._why: UXV-B1: c9 jump to Cassiopeia A from Cygnus X-1; the launched seed and the Whipple shield are both spent, 16 A x V[UIV] for 60 s
recipes.name: hold_cas_a

recipes._why: UXV-B6: c10 gate to OpV at Cygnus X-1, 16 A x V[UXV] = 2^31 EU/t for 60 s; the FRC cartridge burns, the six records stay in the bus, the bulge chart comes out (the casing of OpV is researched with it)
recipes.name: hold_galactic_bulge

recipes._why: OpV-A0: c11 throw of the bulge relay seed to SGR 1806-20 from Cygnus X-1, 16 A x V[UXV] = 2^31 EU/t for 120 s on two UXV 16 A hatches; the bulge chart (c10's) stays in the bus to aim it, the seed leaves launched and UXV-B1's poller places F1's SGR platform (opv/bulge_relay.js keeps the run across a restart)
recipes.name: hold_sgr1806

recipes._why: OpV-R1 (docs/eras/opv.md R1): the pathfinder probe is thrown from the Cygnus X-1 orbit to Terzan 5; the c12 hold places its platform (relay_platforms.json terzan5) and the tier model grants opv-terzan5. The probe is the whole cost: nothing is kept.
recipes.name: hold_terzan5

recipes._why: OpV-G1: the gate to MAX (docs/eras/opv.md "Gate to MAX"). The SGR relay forwards the MAX throw: the hold burns a Kugelblitz core and the launched bulge seed, keeps the census, exotic matter, tetron array, census IV, bulge chart and four cosmic mainframes, and writes the Sgr A* chart that researches gtceu:max_machine_casing. 2^33 EU/t is the whole case 13 network through two OpV 16 A hatches (tune the duration).
recipes.name: hold_sgr_a

recipes._why: MAX-T1 (docs/eras/max.md Bridges): the c14 throw of the galactic-centre relay probe to Sgr A* from Cygnus X-1, 16 A x V[OpV] = 2^33 EU/t for 1,200 t on two OpV 16 A hatches (OpV-S0-2's proven path). The probe is the whole cost; the Sgr A* chart (c13's) stays in the bus to aim it. The probe leaves launched and uxv/kerr_sling.js places F1's Sgr A* platform (relay_platforms.json sgra) and the max-sgra substage follows from the arrival.
recipes.name: hold_sgr_a_probe

recipes._why: MAX-T2 (docs/eras/max.md Bridges, S0-11): the c15 throw of the belt seed from the gate built on the Sgr A* platform (gcyr:black_hole_orbit) to the nuclear star cluster, 16 A x V[OpV] = 2^33 EU/t for 1,200 t on two OpV 16 A hatches (S0-11's proven row hold_s0_max_c15). The seed, which carries the ephemeris that aimed it, is the whole cost; nothing is kept. It leaves launched and uxv/kerr_sling.js places F1's belt platform (relay_platforms.json nsc, source Sgr A*) and the max-nsc substage follows from the arrival.
recipes.name: hold_nsc_belt
